description: Move budgeted money between categories, or between a category and the money that is not budgeted yet, for a month. Creates no transaction.

amount.description: Amount to move (human-readable, e.g., 125.50). Must be positive.

from.description: Category to take the money from (name or ID), or "To Budget" for money that is not budgeted yet

month.description: Month (YYYY-MM or natural language). Defaults to the current month.

to.description: Category to give the money to (name or ID), or "To Budget" to return it to the money that is not budgeted yet

name: transfer_between_categories
